messages:
Emma (SEO): Heads-up — final prelaunch SEO tidy for Friday's webinar landing. Need quick signoffs on keywords, schema JSON-LD, internal link targets, and redirect patterns. Can we do owners + ETA? :hourglass: 
Raj (Design): I can confirm final URLs for the hero + resources section by noon. Will drop the URL map.
Marta - Content: I'll lock the keyword list and microcopy variations today. Priorities: 'LLM inference at scale', 'low-latency LLM serving', 'inference cost optimization'.
Liam - Webdev: FYI our current redirect rules are in /_redirects and Netlify config. If we change canonical targets we need a short maintenance window. What's the exact redirect pattern we want?
Emma (SEO): Proposed redirect pattern for old campaign URLs -> new webinar landing: 301 from /webinars/2024-llm-inference/* -> /webinars/launch-inference-2026$1  (keep querystrings). Also canonical on landing -> /webinars/launch-inference-2026.
Nina (PMM): Microcopy note — add an H2 with 'benchmarks & latency numbers' to capture long-tail queries. Will share the line items.
schema-bot: Reminder: structured-data validator window opens at 15:00 UTC. Run JSON-LD through the validator after deployment.
Raj (Design): Uploaded URL map: https://drive.redwood.ai/links/launch-url-map-v3 — hero: /webinars/launch-inference-2026, resources:/docs/inference-benchmarks, signup:/signup/webinar-inference.
Marta - Content: Draft keyword-to-URL mapping (short):
```
'LLM inference at scale' -> /webinars/launch-inference-2026
'low-latency LLM serving' -> /docs/latency-best-practices
'inference cost optimization' -> /blog/inference-costs-2026
```
Liam - Webdev: Ok. I'll implement redirects and add rel=canonical on the landing. Schedule: deploy redirect rules 17:30 UTC, quick smoke afterwards.
Emma (SEO): For internal linking: add 2 contextual links from /docs/latency-best-practices and /blog/inference-costs-2026 into the landing 'benchmarks' section. Marta can add anchor text.
Marta - Content: I'll add anchor copy and create prefilled CTAs for in-article links.
Nina (PMM): Webinar registration URL needs UTM template: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=inference_launch_2026 — please ensure capture on all CTAs.
Liam - Webdev: Noted. I'll append UTM in the redirect rewrite rules so legacy links map with UTM preserved.
Emma (SEO): Quick schema JSON-LD snippet to include on the landing (events + organization + breadcrumb). Example: 
```
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Launch & Benchmarks Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-07T17:00:00Z",
  "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinars/launch-inference-2026"
}
</script>
```
schema-bot: Validation tip — include both Event and BreadcrumbList for better SERP eligibility.
Raj (Design): Quick question: do we canonicalize blog posts that are repurposed into the landing? We currently have a short post /blog/teaser-inference-2026.
Emma (SEO): We should canonicalize the landing as primary. For the blog teaser set rel=canonical -> /webinars/launch-inference-2026 to avoid duplicate content.
Marta - Content: I'll add a short excerpt on the blog with a canonical tag and inline link to the landing.
Liam - Webdev: I'll push the canonical headers and the redirects in the same deploy. Post-deploy smoke: check 200 for landing, 301 for legacy, and structured-data passes.
Emma (SEO): Owners + ETA recap:
- Keywords + microcopy: Marta — EOD today
- URL map + assets: Raj — 12:00 UTC
- Redirect rules + canonical headers: Liam — deploy 17:30 UTC
- Schema validation: schema-bot / Emma — 15:00 UTC window
- UTMs + CTA wiring: Nina — confirm before deploy
Please respond with :thumbsup: when you have the item done so I can sign off.
Raj (Design): :thumbsup:
Marta - Content: will do, aiming 16:00 my side. :white_check_mark:
Liam - Webdev: :thumbsup: scheduling deploy.
Nina (PMM): Confirmed UTMs are in CTA spec.
schema-bot: Auto-check scheduled at 15:00 UTC — will post results to this thread.
Emma (SEO): Thanks team — will do a final pass after the smoke. If any regressions in structured data or canonicalization show up, ping me immediately.
